data.jobspec:
#!/bin/bash

#FLUX --time=00:10:00
#FLUX --nodes=2
#FLUX --ntasks-per-node=1
#FLUX --cpus-per-task=12
#FLUX --job-name=cs420_project
#FLUX --queue=cse

# NOTE: The PBS directive '-j oe' (join stdout/stderr) is the default behavior
# in Flux when an error file (-e) is not specified.

# The Flux equivalent of PBS_O_WORKDIR is FLUX_SUBMIT_DIR
cd $FLUX_SUBMIT_DIR

#module load valgrind

NUM_RANKS=2
THREADS=12
MATRIX_SIZE=2048
BLOCK_SIZE=512
TILE_SIZE=64

echo "Compiling main"
#mpiicc main.c -std=c99 -lrt -qopenmp -o main -g -O0
mpiicc main.c -std=c99 -lrt -qopenmp -D_POSIX_C_SOURCE=199309L -o main

echo "Running main"
# 'mpirun' is replaced by the Flux native launcher 'flux run'.
# The resource directives request 1 task per node on 2 nodes, so 'flux run'
# will correctly launch 2 MPI ranks, one on each node. The number of OpenMP
# threads is passed as an argument to the application.
#flux run valgrind -v --leak-check=yes ./main -t 12 -n ${MATRIX_SIZE} -b ${BLOCK_SIZE}
flux run ./main -t $THREADS -n $MATRIX_SIZE -b $BLOCK_SIZE -T $TILE_SIZE

#!/bin/bash

#PBS -l walltime=00:10:00
#PBS -l nodes=2:ppn=12
#PBS -N cs420_project
#PBS -q cse
#PBS -j oe

cd $PBS_O_WORKDIR

#module load valgrind

NUM_RANKS=2
THREADS=12
MATRIX_SIZE=2048
BLOCK_SIZE=512
TILE_SIZE=64

echo "Compiling main"
#mpiicc main.c -std=c99 -lrt -qopenmp -o main -g -O0
mpiicc main.c -std=c99 -lrt -qopenmp -D_POSIX_C_SOURCE=199309L -o main

echo "Running main"
#mpirun -np ${NUM_RANKS} -ppn 1 valgrind -v --leak-check=yes ./main -t 12 -n ${MATRIX_SIZE} -b ${BLOCK_SIZE}
mpirun -np ${NUM_RANKS} -ppn 1 ./main -t $THREADS -n $MATRIX_SIZE -b $BLOCK_SIZE -T $TILE_SIZE
